scope: Atomic installation, anchoring, protective bonding and continuity verification of 6 explicitly identified floor-standing 42U server racks, model RACK-42U-600X1200, width 600 mm and depth 1200 mm. UPS, batteries, server-room cooling, fire suppression, access control and the full server room are excluded.
sourceAuthority: Approved data-center MEP project organization, rack manufacturer, installation method author, quality-control service and approving project engineer
projectDocumentsRequired: approved rack schedule with exact rack model and dimensions
manufacturer bonding kit and protective-conductor schedule
accessory schedule for lugs, cage nuts and cable organizers
installation method with fitter-electrician labor and rack-handling quantities
conditional plinth, PDU and vertical-organizer schedules
rack supplier package size and approved retained spare quantity
forbiddenClaims: automatic rack product or configuration selection
universal spare quantity or supplier package
universal accessory, labor, equipment, testing or logistics productivity
UPS, batteries, server-room cooling, fire suppression, access control or full server room included
